name: allkeebs
description: Configure lighting, keymaps and macros on keyboards from almost any brand, in the browser over WebHID.

scripts.build:db: node tools/collect-ids.mjs data data/ids.json && node tools/build-db.mjs src/kbdb.json.gz --qmk data/qmk --qmk data/keychron --qmk data/nuphy --qmk data/sonix --qmk data/epomaker --qmk data/monsgeek --qmk data/cipulot --qmk data/zsa --via data/via/v3 --via data/via/src --via data/viamia/keyboards --via data/keychron/keyboards --via data/nuphy/keyboards --via data/epomaker/keyboards --via data/monsgeek/keyboards --via data/cipulot/keyboards --via tools/definitions --via data/github-via --vial data/vial/keyboards --ids data/ids.json --models tools/models.txt --sources tools/github-via-sources.txt
scripts.build:search: node -e "import('./src/effects.js').then(m => console.log(m.PRESETS.map(m.presetWords).join(' ').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z\s-]/g, ' ')))" > data/glove/corpus.txt && python3 tools/build-vectors.py data/glove/glove50.gz data/glove/corpus.txt src
